content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Chartered Accountant or Cost Accountant or a full time MBA/PGDM course having specialization in Finance with good academic record from a recognized University/Institution; Preference would be given to Chartered Accountant; Officers of Organized Group 'A' Accounts Services and applicants from Central Govt./Armed Forces of the Union/All India Services working at appropriate level are exempted from the educational qualification, provided they have relevant experience as in Para 4 (ii) Experience: At least five years of cumulative experience at a senior level during the last ten years in the area of Corporate Financial Management / Corporate Accounts in an organization of repute. Age limit: Minimum 45 years (On the date of occurrence of vacancy (DOV), 01-03-2027) Other conditions: SPSE, private company, JV or Federation must have annual turnover of Rs. 2,000 crore or more (average audited turnover of three preceding financial years) CPSE applicants: minimum one year (internal) or two years (others) in an eligible pay scale as on the date of vacancy Central Government Group 'A' officers must hold a Joint Secretary level or equivalent post on substantive basis; Armed Forces officers Major General or equivalent Central Government, Armed Forces, AIS, PSB/FI/Autonomous Body officers considered only on immediate absorption basis Only applicants clear from vigilance angle are to be forwarded Desirable: Preference would be given to Chartered Accountant In case of private company, preference to candidates from listed companies

content_sections.text: Persons employed in a contractual/ad-hoc capacity Officers drawing the eligible pay scale merely on Non-Functional Upgradation (NFU) / Next Below Rule (NBR) basis without holding substantive post Applicants who do not give the undertaking to join if selected

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment for five years from the date of joining or up to the date of superannuation or until further orders, whichever is earlier Unwillingness to join after interview or offer of appointment leads to debarment for two years from Board level posts in CPSEs

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for PESB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for PESB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 45 years (On the date of occurrence of vacancy (DOV), 01-03-2027).

faq.answer: Chartered Accountant or Cost Accountant or full time MBA/PGDM with specialization in Finance with good academic record from a recognized University/Institution (preference to Chartered Accountant), plus at least five years of cumulative senior-level experience in the last ten years in Corporate Financial Management / Corporate Accounts in an organization of repute.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. SPSE, private company, JV or Federation must have annual turnover of Rs. 2,000 crore or more (average audited turnover of three preceding financial years). Central Government, Armed Forces, AIS, PSB/FI/Autonomous Body officers considered only on immediate absorption basis.
